title: THE MORNING ALTAR
A PRAYER AT SUNRISE
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: dark mountain valley before dawn blue hour
mist rising over a quiet calm lake at dawn
soft golden morning light filtering through forest trees
warm sunrise glow on an empty mountain meadow
sun breaking over a serene horizon with gentle light
peaceful dawn sky with soft clouds and early morning light

scenes.a: Quiet your heart as the world wakes up around you.
Before the demands of the day pull at your thoughts, step into the quiet.
The gospel records a profound rhythm in the life of Jesus.
Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.
Lord, grant us that same hunger for your presence as this new day begins.
Quiet our anxious thoughts, anchor our hearts in your peace, and walk with us through every moment ahead. Amen.
